name: Egg Bhurji
subtitle: eggs scrambled hard with onion, chilli and tomato, the ten-minute dinner
prepNotes: Bhurji is deliberately dry and crumbly, not soft and creamy. Cook the eggs harder than you would for a Western scramble.
Salt the eggs only as they go in. Salted early, they weep.

steps.text: Crackle the cumin in hot oil, then fry the onion 4 minutes until soft and just colouring.
Add the green chilli and ginger, then the tomato, and cook 3 minutes until it breaks down.
Add the turmeric and chilli powder and cook 30 seconds.
Break the eggs straight into the pan, season, and stir constantly over medium heat.
steps.tip: Straight into the pan, not beaten first: it gives the loose curds bhurji wants.

steps.text: Keep going 3 minutes until the eggs are dry and crumbly with no wet patches.
Scatter coriander and eat immediately with pav or roti.

storage: Eat straight away. Bhurji reheats badly and turns watery in the fridge.
